name: DFT – Dry Film Thickness
description: Magnetic induction and eddy current methods for fast, non-destructive coating thickness measurement on all substrate types.
short_desc: Magnetic induction & eddy current for non-destructive measurement.

name: EDXRF – Energy Dispersive X-Ray Fluorescence
description: Non-destructive X-ray fluorescence measurement for multi-layer coatings, precious metals, and complex substrate systems.
short_desc: Non-destructive XRF for multi-layer coatings & precious metals.

name: Coulometric Method
description: Electrochemical dissolution method for accurate measurement of single-layer coatings — ideal for plating quality control.
short_desc: Electrochemical method for single-layer plating quality control.

name: Beta Backscattering
description: High-precision beta backscattering gauges for thin film measurement in electronics, PCB, and precision engineering.
short_desc: High-precision thin film gauges for electronics & PCB applications.

name: Gold & Jewellery Testing Machine

name: Porosity Testing

short_desc: Elemental analysis for alloys, RoHS & material verification.
